page_title: MNT 1-1 MAR | Montpellier v Marseille 20/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Amine Harit (Marseille) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
90+5' The corner from Amine Harit (Marseille) is cleared away by the defence.
90+3' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Benjamin Lecomte makes a comfortable save.
90+2' A yellow card for a tackle by Teji Savanier (Montpellier). Thomas Leonard doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+2' The resulting corner, taken by Jordan Veretout (Marseille), comes to nothing.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Vitinha (Marseille) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
89' Vitinha (Marseille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
88' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a header which hits the crossbar!
88' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
87' Amine Harit (Marseille) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Now Marseille have a corner.
87' The substitution has been made. Abdoul Bamo Meite (Marseille) has replaced Samuel Gigot.
85' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
83' Kelvin Yeboah (Montpellier) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
82' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) sends a nice lofted cross into the box from the free kick, but his effort is plucked out of the air by Benjamin Lecomte.
80' The statistic for corner kicks – 5:7.
77' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) comes onto the pitch so that Mousa Al Tamari can be given a rest.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Akor Adams leaves the pitch and Kelvin Yeboah (Montpellier) comes on.
73' Iliman Ndiaye will be replaced by Vitinha (Marseille).
72' Gennaro Gattuso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Amine Harit (Marseille) replacing Azzedine Ounahi.
72' Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post.
71' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille).
69' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Chancel Mbemba (Marseille), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
68' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
67' A dangerous looking corner kick from Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is cleared to safety by the defence.

67' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Montpellier.
66' Michael Murillo (Marseille) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Benjamin Lecomte was alert and made a comfortable save.
65' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
65' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
64' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) sends a cross into the box from the free kick, but Pau Lopez leaps into the air and clears the danger.
61' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to substitute Khalil Fayad and he is replaced by Jordan Ferri (Montpellier).
61' It doesn’t look good for Lucas Mincarelli (Montpellier); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
60' The substitution is prepared. Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lucas Mincarelli.
59' Lucas Mincarelli (Montpellier) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
58' Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
55' Samuel Gigot (Marseille) has tested the patience of referee Thomas Leonard and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
55' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) sends in a poor free kick and the ball goes out of play. Back to the drawing board.
55' Akor Adams (Montpellier) is penalised for holding. Thomas Leonard signals a set piece. A free kick has been awarded to Marseille.
52' 1 - 1 Goal! Jordan Veretout (Marseille) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Jonathan Clauss and easily beat the keeper with a header low into the middle of the goal from close range. 1:1.
50' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort high over the bar.
50' The resulting set piece from Marseille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
49' A snap shot by Jordan Veretout (Marseille) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Benjamin Lecomte produces a good save to thwart him.
49' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
48' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) latches on to a pass inside the box, but his low effort towards the right post is well blocked.
48' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) commits a foul and Thomas Leonard immediately signals a free kick.
46' The whistle blows and Thomas Leonard starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' The resulting corner from Jordan Veretout (Marseille) is cleared by the defence.
45+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Marseille.
45+1' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' The resulting set piece from Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) is successfully intercepted by the defender.
44' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Christopher Jullien (Montpellier) was quite harsh and Thomas Leonard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
41' Akor Adams (Montpellier) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
40' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
39' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) makes a strong challenge and Thomas Leonard blows for a foul.
38' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
35' Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but blazes it just over the crossbar.
35' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
33' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
33' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.

31' Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Pau Lopez makes a great save to stop his effort.
29' Chancel Mbemba (Marseille) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
27' A precise low pass is received by Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
25' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
24' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
23' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
21' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
18' Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
16' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) produces a long-range pass.
14' 1 - 0 Goal! Maxime Esteve finds Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) and he shows great determination to get to the ball and plant a header into the back of the net. 1:0.
14' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) will deliver the corner kick.
13' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but powers a header just over the bar.
13' Marseille earn a corner.
12' Marseille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

12' Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Marseille.
11' A raking crossfield pass from Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
10' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
8' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Pau Lopez makes a great save.
7' Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
6' Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
4' Akor Adams (Montpellier) fails to score from the rebound as the goalkeeper stops his effort from hitting the net.
3' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle and signals a foul after Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) brought his opponent down.
